AxTableField.Name: TerminalId
AxTableField.HelpText: POS terminal number as it appears on the acquirer's settlement file.
AxTableField.Label: Terminal ID

AxTableField.Name: MerchantId
AxTableField.HelpText: Merchant code the bank prints in the statement narration, such as SE2226. Without it a UPI settlement line cannot be traced back to this terminal.
AxTableField.Label: Merchant code

AxTableField.Name: TerminalName
AxTableField.HelpText: Name used to identify this terminal on screens and reports.
AxTableField.Label: Terminal name

AxTableField.Name: BranchCode
AxTableField.HelpText: Maruti outlet code for the branch this terminal stands in.
AxTableField.Label: Outlet code

AxTableField.Name: BranchName
AxTableField.HelpText: Branch where the terminal is installed.
AxTableField.Label: Branch name

AxTableField.Name: StateCode
AxTableField.HelpText: State the terminal operates in. Decides whether GST on the MSF is CGST/SGST or IGST.
AxTableField.Label: State

AxTableField.Name: DefaultDimension
AxTableField.HelpText: Dimensions applied to the postings generated for this terminal.
AxTableField.Label: Financial dimensions

AxTableField.Name: SettlementBankAccount
AxTableField.HelpText: Bank account the acquirer credits the settlement into.
AxTableField.Label: Settlement bank account

AxTableField.Name: ClearingBankAccount
AxTableField.HelpText: Bank account in Cash and bank management that holds the collections of this terminal (PhonePe, MobiKwik, PayZapp). When set, the POS credit of the settlement posts to this bank account instead of the POS receivable ledger account.
AxTableField.Label: Clearing bank account

AxTableField.Name: POSReceivableAccount
AxTableField.HelpText: Ledger account holding card sales until the acquirer settles them. The settlement journal offsets this account.
AxTableField.Label: POS receivable account

AxTableField.Name: BankClearingAccount
AxTableField.HelpText: Clearing account used when the settlement passes through an intermediate step.
AxTableField.Label: Bank clearing account

AxTableField.Name: MSFExpenseAccount
AxTableField.HelpText: Ledger account the merchant service fee is charged to.
AxTableField.Label: MSF expense account

AxTableField.Name: MSFRate
AxTableField.HelpText: Merchant service fee percentage agreed with the acquirer for this terminal.
AxTableField.Label: MSF rate (%)

AxTableField.Name: GSTRate
AxTableField.HelpText: GST percentage charged on the merchant service fee.
AxTableField.Label: GST rate (%)

AxTableField.Name: IsIntraState
AxTableField.HelpText: Yes splits GST on the MSF into CGST and SGST; No charges IGST.
AxTableField.Label: Intra-state

AxTableField.Name: MSFVendorAccount
AxTableField.HelpText: Vendor the merchant service fee is payable to.
AxTableField.Label: Acquirer vendor account

AxTableField.Name: LegalEntity
AxTableField.HelpText: Company this terminal belongs to.
AxTableField.Label: Legal entity

AxTableField.Name: IsActive
AxTableField.HelpText: Only active terminals are considered while matching settlements.
AxTableField.Label: Active

AxTableField.Name: ValidFrom
AxTableField.HelpText: Leave blank for no start limit.
AxTableField.Label: Valid from

AxTableField.Name: ValidTo
AxTableField.HelpText: Leave blank for no end limit.
AxTableField.Label: Valid to

AxTableField.Name: SysCreatedBy
AxTableField.HelpText: User who created this row.
AxTableField.Label: Created by

AxTableField.Name: SysCreatedDateTime
AxTableField.HelpText: When this row was created.
AxTableField.Label: Created on

AxTableField.Name: UserModifiedBy
AxTableField.HelpText: User who last changed this row.
AxTableField.Label: Modified by

AxTableField.Name: UserModifiedDateTime
AxTableField.HelpText: When this row was last changed.
AxTableField.Label: Modified on
